newsitem.title: CHINA: China insurer sets 7.42 mln yuan payout on ship.
newsitem.headline: China insurer sets 7.42 mln yuan payout on ship.

text.p: A subsidiary of the People's Insurance Company of China (PICC) has paid 7.42 million yuan ($893,000) in compensation for damages to a cargo vessel that caught fire last year, the Financial News said on Thursday.

The PICC Yantai branch, in the eastern province of Shandong, made the payment to the Yantai Hengtong Shipping Co, owner of the Heixin One, which caught fire near Shantou in south China's Guangdong province.
The vessel was on route from Tianjin to Hong Kong. It did not give further details.
PICC Property is the largest property insurance company in China.

The newspaper also said the Shenzhen-based Pingan Insurance Co's Qingdao branch in Shandong province made a 1.7 million yuan payment on a Qingdao warehouse that caught fire in January. It did not provide details.
